title: DATALAB: A Platform for Data Analysis and Intervention

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the ratio of male and female names or words in the dataset using a multidimensional gender dictionary.
Classifying text samples into hate speech, offensive language, and neither using an off-the-shelf 'hatesonar' tool to determine the proportion of hate speech in a dataset.
Using Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) to measure associations between specific dataset features (e.g., sentence length) and assigned labels to identify unintended shortcuts.
